checks.name: Partition Boundary Verification
checks.requirement: Operate strictly on 107 development tiles; locked holdout (107) and quarantine (42) untouched.
checks.evidence: Split manifest loaded: len(dev_tiles)==107, dev_tiles disjoint with holdout and quarantined partitions.

checks.name: Primary Comparison Reproduction
checks.requirement: Reproduce 20% budget comparison across S0, Hybrid, Sobel, Random, and Full Ensemble.
checks.evidence: Matched EXP-020A Phase 2 and EXP-021 metrics to full floating-point precision (Hybrid vs Random MAE Δ = -0.00222, p = 9.86e-22).

checks.name: Distribution & Outlier Robustness
checks.requirement: Test sensitivity under exclusion of top 1 and top 5 most influential tiles.
checks.evidence: All paired comparisons remain statistically significant at p < 10^-7 even after excluding top 5 most influential tiles.

checks.name: Replacement Fraction Consistency
checks.evidence: Hybrid significantly outperforms random control at all fractions (10%: Δ = -0.00152, 20%: Δ = -0.00222, 30%: Δ = -0.00253, all p < 10^-20).

checks.name: Observable Diagnostic Associations
checks.requirement: Analyze associations between observable features and improvement without unverified semantic labels.
checks.evidence: Temporal disagreement (r = 0.582, p = 1.3e-10) and hybrid uncertainty p90 (r = 0.505, p = 2.4e-8) correlate strongly with S0 improvement.

checks.name: Spatial Group Robustness
checks.requirement: Verify that conclusions are consistent across spatial folds and not driven by a single cluster.
checks.evidence: Hybrid beats Random control across all 5 spatial folds (Fold win rates: 90.5%, 95.2%, 95.2%, 86.4%, 90.9%; all p < 10^-3).

checks.name: Reconstruction Guardrail Compliance
checks.requirement: Gradient magnitude evaluated consistently without claiming enhanced super-resolution.
checks.evidence: Report explicitly states gradient magnitude is an aggregate variance proxy and lower MAE reflects variance reduction.
